source.note: Public repository downloaded as an archive and inspected read-only. Its .env (real backend credentials) was excluded from inspection and is never copied into this project.

decisions.decision: The application database and accounts stay in the user's own Neon PostgreSQL; Lovable Cloud is not used for app data.
decisions.consequence: The app's existing gateway transport (NEON_API_KEY + LOVABLE_API_KEY) is what it already expects, so no data-layer rewrite is needed once the Neon connection is linked to this project.

decisions.decision: Renumber the duplicated 0169 script and rebuild the offline schema record so the migration checks pass.
decisions.consequence: db/0169_workspace_icon.sql became db/0172_workspace_icon.sql (the other 0169 script had to keep its number because db/0171 reads the table it creates); db/schema.snapshot.json and src/lib/db-types.gen.ts were rebuilt with the project's own offline replay script.

capabilities.next_action: Confirm in Neon which scripts were applied: the renamed db/0172_workspace_icon.sql now looks un-applied to the migration runner, and its statements are idempotent so re-applying is safe.
